_doc: Basecamp Hell NPC models (characters-new, docs/team/characters-new.md). scene drives itself (idle + gestures) when added outside an Enemy; call talk() / gesture(1) on it. speaker: Dialogue speaker id (data/dialogue/speakers.json). height: approx. head height in m (for prompt / name plates). Ambient entries are crowd dressing.

breachwarden.name: Kesh, the Breachwarden
breachwarden.speaker: kesh
breachwarden.role: keeper of the portal (gesture 1 = slams the halberd: the portal opens)

imp_porter.name: Imp Porter
imp_porter.role: ambient: carries sacks around the camp

hellhound_resting.name: Hellhound
hellhound_resting.role: ambient: lies by a fire, lifts its head on gestures

hell_brute.name: Hell Brute
hell_brute.role: ambient: labourer / guard, beats its chest

sable.name: Sable, the Barkeep
sable.speaker: sable
sable.role: succubus barkeep of the Infernal Bar (the counter is solid)
lines: What'll it be? Brimstone sour? Liquid regret? We have a lot of regret.
Drink up. Up there, everything tastes of incense.
The angels never tip. You'd think, with all that gold.
Pip owes me eleven souls. If you see Pip, you didn't hear it from me.
That one's on the house. The house is on fire, but still.
You look like someone who just got smited. Smote? Smitten. No.

kennel.name: The Hellhound Kennel
kennel.role: a pen of three hellhounds (the pen is solid)
lines: The hounds press their smoking muzzles to the bars. The iron hisses.
The biggest one rolls over. Its belly is very warm. Too warm.
Three tails thump against the basalt in perfect time.
The sleeper opens one ember eye, decides you are not an angel, and closes it again.
One drops a gnawed halo at your feet. It wants you to throw it.

damned_hauler.name: Damned Laborer
damned_hauler.role: ambient: drags a stone block back and forth (patrols)

damned_carrier.name: Damned Laborer
damned_carrier.role: ambient: carries lava buckets on a yoke (patrols)

damned_miner.name: A Damned Soul
damned_miner.speaker: damned_soul
damned_miner.role: swings a pick at an ember rock forever; talkable
lines: Hello... sir? Madam? Hellspawn? I break the rock. The rock grows back. I break the rock.
I was a tax collector. This is fair.
Do you know what year it is up there? No. Don't tell me.
They say if I break it a million times I can rest. This is nine hundred thousand and... no, I lost count again.
You're going up? Spit on a cathedral for me.

_basecamp_doc: Placed in Basecamp Hell by CharacterRoster.populate_basecamp(hub) (called from basecamp.gd _ready). The talkable story NPCs (pip, breachwarden, malphine) are placed by the story role's StoryHooks instead (StoryNpc). Entries may set 'collision' (cylinder radius in m, 0 = none): spawn_npc adds a StaticBody3D on world layer 1 so the avatar can't walk through. pos = hub-local [x, y, z] (see HubScenery: FIRE (0,0,1), GATE (0,0,-10.5), SMITH (-10,0,-3)); yaw in degrees, 0 faces -Z, 180 faces the camera. Entries with 'talk': true are wrapped in a HubNpc (scenes/characters/npcs/hub_npc.gd: verb, lines, speaker pool, 'narrate' for narration lines). 'patrol' = [x, y, z] offset walked back and forth (laborers). The basecamp role's HubLife builds its own bar (Velka), kennel and quarry souls from these models, so 'sable', 'kennel' and the damned_* entries are offered as ready-made set pieces but not placed by default (add them to this list to place them).
